hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf %s "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$CMD" in *"git commit"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f tools/check-instructions-size.sh ] || exit 0; OUT=$( { sh tools/check-instructions-size.sh --staged; sh tools/check-instructions-size.sh; } 2>&1 ) || jq -n --arg r "$OUT" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: $r}}'; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Checking AGENTS.md size against Codex limit...

hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); echo "$FILE" | grep -iqE '\.(R|r|qmd|Rmd)$' && command -v air >/dev/null 2>&1 && air format "$FILE" 2>&1 || true

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); case "$FILE" in *AGENTS.md) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f tools/check-instructions-size.sh ] || exit 0; sh tools/check-instructions-size.sh >&2; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Checking AGENTS.md size against Codex limit...

language: Use Japanese for chat conversations, English for writing files
